_comment: Symbols vendored identically into multiple operator/skills/*/pre_run.py: the seven stamps of templates/pre_run_gate.py (eight until 2026-09-17, when routine 11 lost its schedule and medical-chronology-maintainer/pre_run.py was deleted), the inline heartbeat writer classes, and the one-line wrappers over templates/skill_helpers.py (the shared library bodies live there since 2026-09-11, gated by operator/tests/test_skill_helpers_sync.py).
